text: Materials engineering is an interdisciplinary subject based on the theory of materials science, which studies the preparation process, performance optimization, application development and engineering issues of materials. Its core lies in solving key technical problems from laboratory research and development to industrial production of materials through theories from multiple disciplines such as physics, chemistry, and mechanics. It covers fields such as metallic materials, ceramic materials, polymer materials, composite materials, and functional materials, and serves as the fundamental support for modern industries like aerospace, electronic information, energy, and healthcare.
